people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Eshtemoa
people.line: Levitical city in Judah; received spoils from David's victory

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Jattir
people.line: A town in the hill country of Judah

people.name: Libnah
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua; a Levitical city

translations.web: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,
translations.bsb: So the descendants of Aaron were given Hebron (a city of refuge), Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa,
translations.kjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
translations.asv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its suburbs,
